QF.id: III-C Prevention of Money Laundering Act_12

question.text: Under the PMLA, cash transactions above what value must be recorded by reporting entities?

explanation.text: The Logic: Every reporting entity must maintain records of cash transactions of more than ten lakh rupees or the equivalent in foreign currency (NISM-Series-III-C workbook, pp.162 and 182). The Trap: Five lakhs, one crore, and twenty lakhs do not match the more-than-ten-lakhs CTR threshold on pp.162 and 182. Note: The connected-series wording in the workbook (p.174) is associated with STR identification, so anchor this question on the standalone cash-transaction threshold from pp.162 and 182.
